source_behavior: SPL first calls spl_nand_load_element at 0x800000. If it returns an error, it calls the redundant location 0xc00000.
The sunxi SPL NAND reader detects normal ECC/randomizer configuration at the requested location. An empty first ECC sector prevents configuration detection and returns EINVAL.
The historical NAND instructions program SPL at 0 and 0x400000 and U-Boot at 0x800000; they do not independently demonstrate programming or use of 0xc00000.
measured_relation: Linux labels 0xc00000 env, but all raw data and OOB are erased. The label does not determine current firmware use.
Both original and RAM-recovery observations agree that this fourth boot block is erased.
limitations: Current hash comparisons bind both preserved local rebuilt SPL/U-Boot pairs to the original and locked programs; no new rebuild was performed in this check, and redundant U-Boot fallback remains physically untested.
Redundant U-Boot behavior and BROM primary/backup search require controlled physical testing.
The final plan still schedules no operation at 0xc00000.
